name: .458 Cal-404gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist rate is 1-19″ dangerous game or 1-22″ big game. Recommended use: Dangerous Game Hunting and Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "We designed this big bore Stone Hammer™ on the request of a customer who wanted the one gun one bullet solution for Hammering anything in the world. Here is the result. A 3mm hollow point that will open easily and produce robust heavy petals with enough weight retention to give deep penetration on the toughest of animals."
